title: Chapter 638 - 638 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing! (2)
content:
Chapter 638 - 638 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing! (2)

Chapter 638 - 638 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing! (2)

638 Meeting Wang Fengyi; Unsealing! (2)

“Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes, hello.”

“Are you satisfied with this place?” Wang Zhihai asked.

“The food, the environment, and the decorations are all good,” Lin Fan said.

Wang Zhihai, as the old head of the Wang family, had heard countless flattering words in his life.

But now, after hearing Lin Fan, who looked like a young man in his 20s, give a few simple words of praise, his entire face turned red.

“Mr. Lin, thank you for your praise,” Wang Zhihai said excitedly.

“Our Wang family has always adhered to the teachings of our ancestors and worked hard to build the Imperial Hotel into a more popular and high-end hotel… In this way, we could welcome your return with a better appearance.

“Now that I have your approval, it’s really, really great!”

Wang Zhihai’s words were very sincere. It could even be said that they came from the bottom of his heart.

Lin Fan nodded his head.

Then, the two of them had a short conversation about the situation at the Imperial Hotel.

At this moment, Wang Zhihai seemed to have thought of something and said, “The reason why our Imperial Hotel could reach its current state was entirely due to your trust in our Wang family, as well as the planning and implementation of our ancestor, Wang Fengyi…

“Wang Fengyi was always worried about you. When his life was about to end, he sealed himself in a hibernation chamber and left a will. Only when you appeared could the hibernation chamber be opened… I wonder, are you willing to meet Wang Fengyi?”

…

Speaking of Wang Fengyi, Lin Fan could not help but think of that man who was always smiling, capable, and efficient.

Frozen in a hibernation chamber?

From a certain perspective, Wang Fengyi was the first old friend he had heard of after a thousand years.

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, let’s go and meet him.”

“Thank you, Mr. Lin,” Wang Haizhi said happily.

When Lin Fan arrived at the entrance of the Imperial Hotel, there was a long line of luxurious hover cars waiting outside.

The passersby in the distance all stopped and looked at him, sighing from time to time.

Lin Fan boarded the hover car at the front. The car drove through a winding road, a beautiful path lined with greenery, and a clear bridge over the river.

Finally, he arrived in front of an extremely spacious manor with beautiful scenery.

This was the Wang family’s courtyard.

Under the introduction of Wang Zhihai, Wang Qianjin, Wang You, and the others, Lin Fan moved forward.

A moment later, Lin Fan arrived at a steel laboratory underneath the courtyard.

In front of the laboratory door, there were a few big words—’Hibernation Chamber 0′.

Yesterday, Lin Fan had learned from the super smart watch that 50 years after he touched the ball of light, a scientist named Felian had invented a machine called the hibernation chamber.

This kind of machine had the special ability to freeze a person and could suspend all life activities in the human body.

Obviously, Wang Zhihai had chosen this method.

However, later research found that this method of freezing had a huge side effect.

That was, once the human was thawed, the organs and body of the human body would not be able to withstand it. The individual would die in a very short period of time.

Because of this flaw, the hibernation chamber technology was later banned from use worldwide.

At this moment, two medical staff in protective clothing were standing in front of the door.

When they saw Wang Haizhi and the others, they greeted them one after another, “Hello, Mr. Wang.”

It was very simple to greet the Wang family.

They directly addressed all of them as Mr. Wang.

The women were directly addressed as Madam Wang.

They could not go wrong by doing this.

“Open it.” Wang Haizhi nodded.

“Yes,” the two of them responded.

The door slowly opened, and a bone-piercing chill spread out, making people involuntarily shiver.

At this moment, an old man with white hair, age spots all over his face, and no teeth in his mouth was frozen in a transparent container without moving.

Even though he was already very old, Lin Fan could still recognize him easily. That was Wang Fengyi.

When Wang Haizhi saw Wang Fengyi, his face could not help but reveal a hint of excitement.

This was his ancestor, the great existence who had led the Wang family to glory.

Everyone in the Wang family had grown up listening to his deeds, and there was almost no one who did not admire him.

Now, he could see the man with his own eyes.

They might even be able to exchange a few words.

How could Wang Haizhi not be excited?

After a while, Wang Haizhi suppressed the excitement in his heart and asked respectfully, “Mr. Lin, what do you think of the idea of unfreezing him now?”

When he said this, Wang Haizhi’s face revealed a touch of sorrow.

It was because once Wang Fengyi was unfrozen, he would soon die for good.

“Okay, let’s do it.” Lin Fan nodded.

His expression and tone were very calm.

It was as if he did not know the consequences of unfreezing Wang Fengyi.

With a soft sound, the frozen container began to melt quickly.

After about 30 minutes, it turned into a green solution.

Then, Wang Fengyi, who had a head full of white hair, suddenly opened his eyes and popped his head out of the solution.

He lay beside the container and panted heavily, as if he could die at any moment.

About a minute later, Wang Fengyi finally caught his breath.

He used his turbid eyes to scan his surroundings.

Soon, his gaze landed on Lin Fan.

Instantly, Wang Fengyi became extremely excited and shouted, “M-Mr. Lin, you’re back!

“I knew it. I knew you’d definitely come back.”

Perhaps it was because he was too excited or because of the hibernation chamber’s side effects, Wang Fengyi suddenly could not breathe. His entire face was deathly pale, as if he would faint at any moment.

Seeing this…

“Doctor!” Wang Haizhi shouted anxiously. “Doctor, hurry up!”

Lin Fan said, “Don’t worry.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan waved his hand casually.

A gentle green light spread out and instantly enveloped Wang Fengyi.

[Skill: Perfect Radiance of Life.]

Soon, Wang Fengyi regained his breathing. His originally sallow face had an additional tinge of red.

Then, Wang Fengyi’s white hair started to turn black.

Immediately after, his skinny body plumped up.

When Wang Fengyi entered the hibernation chamber, he was already a 110-year-old man.

However, at this moment, he looked like a young man in his 40s.

Wang Haizhi, who was beside him, saw everything.

His eyes widened in disbelief.

With just a raise of Lin Fan’s hand, Lin Fan could heal the person who walked out of the hibernation chamber and make him return to his youth!

This…

What kind of power was this?

It was a miracle!

In the past, Wang Haizhi had often heard of Lin Fan’s legends.

However, there were no videos or images of Lin Fan.

Therefore, Wang Haizhi only treated them as legends and did not take them to heart.

At this moment, he suddenly felt… Perhaps, those were not legends at all but things that really happened!

…

As for Lin Fan, his expression was still as calm as ever.

Wang Fengyi looked at his hands that had become stronger and said excitedly, “Thank you, Mr. Lin. Thank you!”

Clearly, he knew that this was Lin Fan’s doing.

Only Lin Fan could possess such a powerful ability.

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “It’s rare to see a friend from back then. I’m just helping out a little.

“This is definitely a small favor in your eyes, but it saved my life!” Wang Fengyi said. “I don’t know how to thank you, but I’ll definitely serve you well like I did back then!”

His tone was extremely serious and sincere.

Obviously, those were his true thoughts.

However, Lin Fan did not care too much about it. He said, “Oh right, this is Wang Haizhi, the grandfather of the current general manager of the Imperial Hotel.”

When Wang Haizhi heard Lin Fan’s words, he finally recovered from his shock.

“Wang Haizhi, kneel down and kowtow to your ancestor!” he said excitedly.

A white-haired old man kowtowed to a middle-aged man with black hair and called him his ancestor…

This scene was really strange.

However, everyone present felt that it was only natural.
